status: The actual AI reference pilot contains 200 real MSFT tweets: 117 usable labels (31 positive, 67 neutral, 19 negative) and 83 explicit exclusions. Its frozen split is 93 development/24 held out, with only two negative held-out references. One session pass is recorded with full prompt/input/raw-output/timing and declared model-identity provenance; agreement/kappa are null and independent human validation is absent. Candidate inference remains blocked with null metrics.
task: Sentiment expressed about a named US equity in a social post, independent of its subsequent return

required: Document source, access/license conditions, acquisition date and selection rules
Record a real source URL/identifier and publication timestamp
Predeclare target equities and time windows
Keep the evaluation subset fixed before model/prompt selection
avoid: Selecting examples because a model already classifies them well
Treating news headlines as an equity-social benchmark
Using subsequent price movement to decide sentiment labels
Invented posts or model-generated labels presented as human evidence

labels.positive: The post expresses a favourable view of the target equity or its prospects
labels.negative: The post expresses an unfavourable view of the target equity or its prospects
labels.neutral: Relevant descriptive content without a clear favourable/unfavourable stance
labels.exclude_or_adjudicate: Unclear ticker, irrelevance, inaccessible content, mixed/sarcastic/ambiguous stance that cannot be resolved consistently

procedure: Annotate target/original text only without candidate outputs
Preserve actual model identity evidence, prompt, hashes, raw labels/reasons and run timing
Optional separate pass retains initial disagreements and adjudication
annotation.boundary: AI reference agreement is not independently human-validated accuracy. Single-pass reliability statistics are null.

implemented_tooling.scope: Validate declared provenance, separate labels/adjudication/exclusions; freeze chronological selection and exact checkpoint/preprocessing/data/code identities; score complete paired actual outputs
implemented_tooling.boundary: Schemas cannot authenticate source rights/model identities/blindness. Candidate outputs and independent human validation remain absent.
implemented_tooling.actual_study_status: Actual 200-post AI reference pilot frozen; candidate inference blocked

evaluation: Compare the proposed CryptoBERT checkpoint with a documented social-domain alternative
Evaluate macro-F1, per-class precision/recall and confusion matrices on exactly the same held-out posts
Preserve checkpoint identifiers, preprocessing, model outputs and dataset hashes
Use the proposal's news-only fallback if social transfer is inadequate, with the decision and limits disclosed
pending_inputs: Genuine candidate weights/runtime and supported Cardiff format
Review/adequacy decisions, institutional facts and deadline
